# SCI-FRUIT conditional core — scientific decision disposition

Status: draft Stage A r0.2; no new scientific decision is recorded by this table.
Scientific owner and resolution authority: Grant Wilson. Date: 2026-09-06.

The September 6 owner decision approves a conditional core with no numerical
profile and permits its separately approved authorship before qualification.
It does not close the older method-specific questions. The rows below preserve
those separate questions and distinguish what can be derived from what must
remain unselected. References to Scope sections are to [SCOPE_BRIEF.md](SCOPE_BRIEF.md).

An approved *topic* is not an approved numerical answer. For each deferred
choice, the core may state an implication under an explicit premise. It must
not claim that the premise holds for an available method. The table delegates
no new science beyond the six questions in the owner-approved core scope.

The manager's readiness assessment is therefore conditional and reviewable:
none of the rows requires selecting a numerical method merely to define the
input/output roles and derive conditional implications. If the author finds
a core statement that needs an additional scientific choice, identify that
statement, the missing premise and the exact blocked consequence for the owner.
Do not invent a default or consult excluded implementation material.
